title: Server rules
intro: Welcome. Read these rules, then tap I agree to get the member role.
rules: Be respectful. No harassment, hate speech, or personal attacks.
No spam, scams, or advertising without staff approval.
Keep conversations in the right channels.
No NSFW, gore, or illegal content.
Do not share anyone's personal or private information.
Follow Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.
Listen to staff. Open a ticket if you need help or want to appeal.
footer: Breaking the rules can lead to a warning, a timeout, or a ban.
